item.title: Federal judge approves plan for Syracuse Catholic church to pay millions in sex abuse settlements while avoiding bankruptcy
item.description: After five years of court procedures, a federal judge approved a plan to reorganize the finances of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Syracuse, resulting in a $176.1 million settlement to be paid to hundreds of children who were sexually abused by Catholic clergy.
